definitions.explanation: The elementary school student government, composed of elected representatives from upper grades who run assemblies and student-led activities. The middle/high school counterpart is the {生徒会|せいとかい}.

examples.japanese: {児童会|じどうかい}に{入|はい}った。
{児童会|じどうかい}の{会長|かいちょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was elected president of the student council.

examples.japanese: {児童会|じどうかい}の{活動|かつどう}を{通|つう}じてリーダーシップを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned leadership through student council activities.

notes:
{児童|じどう} (children, used officially for elementary-school pupils) + {会|かい} (association). Specifically the elementary-school student council; junior high and high school have a {生徒会|せいとかい} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {児童会|じどうかい}の{会長|かいちょう}: student council president
- {児童会|じどうかい}{役員|やくいん}: student council officer
- {児童会|じどうかい}{活動|かつどう}: student council activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生徒会|せいとかい}: student council (junior high / high school)
- {学生会|がくせいかい}: student government (university)
- PTA: parent-teacher association — for parents, not students
